heading: Deploy
cmds: kubectl -n s13-hpa apply -f deployment.yaml -f service.yaml; kubectl -n s13-hpa rollout status deploy/hpa-demo
kubectl -n s13-hpa apply -f hpa.yaml; sleep 40; kubectl -n s13-hpa get hpa
kubectl -n s13-hpa get pods; kubectl -n s13-hpa top pods

heading: Load
cmds: kubectl -n s13-hpa apply -f load-generator.yaml; kubectl -n s13-hpa wait --for=condition=Ready pod/load-genera

heading: Load
cmds: watch: kubectl get hpa / kubectl get pods / kubectl top pods   (every 15s while under load)

heading: Load
cmds: kubectl -n s13-hpa get hpa; kubectl -n s13-hpa get pods -l app=hpa-demo

heading: Stop Load
cmds: watch: kubectl get hpa (every 30s after load stopped; scale-down waits the 5 min stabilization window)

heading: Stop Load
cmds: kubectl -n s13-hpa get hpa; kubectl -n s13-hpa get pods -l app=hpa-demo; kubectl -n s13-hpa describe hpa hpa-d
